name: Holds Delegation
description: An AWS Organizations organization holds a delegated administration (organization -> delegation): one (member account, service principal) pair that organizations:RegisterDelegatedAdministrator created and DeregisterDelegatedAdministrator(AccountId, ServicePrincipal) removes. Containment: the organization declares it in CONTAINMENT_EDGES. Its listing is ListDelegatedAdministrators plus one ListDelegatedServicesForAccount per delegated account, recorded as ONE organization-wide completeness surface, complete only when every one of those calls read to its end (req-aws-core-organizations-completeness-13): a surface per inner call would nominate every other account's delegations.
